purpose: Strategy families already measured dead on Polymarket BTC 5m/15m. quant/prereg.is_known_dead(rule) rejects a hypothesis whose leg/exit/entry-field set matches a signature; the LLM reads this file and must state novelty_vs_prior against it.

signature_semantics.match_order: families are listed most specific first; the first signature that matches wins
signature_semantics.exit.mode: rule exit mode must equal this (string 'hold_to_settle' and {mode:'hold_to_settle'} are the same)
signature_semantics.side: if present, rule.side must equal this
signature_semantics.entry_fields_subset_of: every base column used in entry.when (prefixes abs:/other: stripped; ask/bid count as fields) plus side_field must be inside this list
signature_semantics.entry_fields_any_of: at least one entry field must be in this list
signature_semantics.entry_fields_none_of: no entry field may be in this list
signature_semantics.t_el_min_ge: the rule has a t_el >= v (or t_el > v, or between with lo) condition with v >= this

families.evidence:
paired_maker STEP-3 replay, 19 BME days 2026-09-26..10-14, both sides joining the best bid over the whole quote window: at order latency 0.1 s net -4.48% of cost with 84% of pairs completed; even at instant latency (lat 0, the ceiling) -0.20%.
Live probe measured 72-128 ms book-to-order from twapvm, so the 0.1 s row is the realistic one; project STOPPED 2026-10-27, bot DRY-locked.
families.result: FAIL -4.48% (lat 0.1) / -0.20% (instant); pairs complete but leftover legs lose

families.evidence:
v2-open-maker-inspect-order-book lab, 19 replay days: posting both sides at a fixed t_el (timed posts) nets -4.5% .. -18% of cost depending on the window; odd/even price parity best -1.8c/share; sell-at-once worse than hold.
34 of 34 book rules FAIL (2026-10-27); maker rebate recovers only ~0.6% (20% of the 0.07*p*(1-p) taker fee).

Same 19-day inspect-order-book lab: sweep, imbalance and flow filters on a resting maker leg only cut the loss to -0.5% by not trading (trade count collapses to a handful per day); no filter made the maker leg positive.
open_book_maker_v2 variant sweep V0-V7 (12 runs, 2026-10-15): edge -2.4 .. -5.7c/share, all FAIL; the live $10/side test lost $32.60 in 25 min, 3 of 3 filled rounds adverse.

A single-side resting bid held to settlement fills only when the taker flow is against it (adverse selection): open_book_maker went LIVE $10/side 2026-10-10 and lost $32.60 in 25 min (3/3 filled rounds adverse), then 12 replay variants on 19 days all FAIL at -2.4 .. -5.7c/share.
EXP-D naked legs won 0 of 1,092 (a resting bid fills on the losing side); S3 fee-farm / S6 coin-flip 0.45-0.49 quoters never showed a positive holdout.

wallet_audits/signal_taker_replay.py: lift the ask whenever it is stale versus a spot-based fair value (gap condition on spot vs open, no momentum), landing at t+0.1 s, fill only if the ask is still there: gross -3.0% .. -4.7% of cost per day, 0 of 19 BME days positive before fees.
The calibrated fair_model from open_book_maker_v2 gives the same sign; the ask that is still there 100 ms later is the one that was right.

S1 TWAP lock-in late-round taker (t_el >= 240 s, buy the favourite): measurement-stack 7-day backtest against public chain labels -$56.57, no edge; the leader's price already contains the 60-s TWAP lock, so the fee 0.07*p*(1-p) is the whole trade.
norm1e69 audit 2026-10-27 (the '+$315k maker robot'): 80% taker, buys both sides every round at any price, nets only +0.09c/share after fees; the profit is taker-rebate tier income, not edge.
families.result: FAIL -$56.57 / 7 days; +0.09c/share net for the best known taker

notes: Thorp vol edge (2-4 bps) died with the 2026-08-07 60-s TWAP settlement rule change: post-change -4.32pp.
BTC5 flat-book conditional gate (0.45-0.60): 1/10 wins out of sample, do not rebuild.
EXP-D legged hedge: -$42,347 not +$11,697 once the fill side is modelled.
Profitable top-line wallets are speed makers at scale (gabigol: pure maker, pairs make it, leftover legs lose) or rebate farms (norm1e69); neither is copyable at $5 size.
Numbers above are MEASURED on BME replay days unless the line says live.
